.....Respondents The Court made the following:
 -2-  HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE P.NAVEEN RAO  AND  HON'BLE SMT Dr.JUSTICE G.RADHA RANI  WRIT PETITION No.28586 of 2021 ORDER:
(per Hon'ble Sri Justice P.Naveen Rao) This writ petition is filed seeking the following relief :
P Keshav vs The State Of Telangana And 2 Others on 17 February, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98106805/
1 "...to issue an appropriate Writ, Order or Direction, more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Habeas Corpus, directing 3rd respondent to produce the detenue i.e., Allani Shyam now detained in Central Prison, Cherlapally, Medchal-Malkajgiri District before this Hon'ble Court and set-aside the impugned detention order passed by the 2nd respondent vide No.47/PD CELL/CCRB/RCKD/2021 dated 25.05.2021 and confirmation order vide G.O.Rt.No.1713, dated 31.07.2021 passed by the 1st respondent as being illegal, arbitrary, improper, unilateral, unconstitutional and violative of Article 21 and 22 of the Constitution of India, and to forthwith release the Detenue and to grant such other relief or reliefs..."
2.

This writ petition is instituted by the friend of detenu Allani Shyam, challenging the order of detention dated 25.05.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders,
Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders,
Cyber Crime offenders and While Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986).
3.

entities.text: Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard Sri P.Trivikram Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for home.

4. The order of detention is passed on the allegation of involvement in only Cr.No.148 of 2021 registered under Section 370 (A) of Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 and 5 of Immoral Trafficking (Prevention) Act, 1956 in Chaitanyapuri Police Station.
5. The co-accused in the same crime against whom order of detention was passed on 26.05.2021 filed W.P.No.17070 of 2021 challenging the detention order therein.
This Court by order dated 06.12.2021 allowed the said writ petition setting aside the order of detention.

6. When the matter is called learned counsel for the petitioner as well learned Government Pleader submits that the subject matter of the writ petition is covered by the decision of this Court in W.P.No.17070 of 2021.
7.
Following the same, and for the reasons assigned therein, this writ petition is also allowed setting aside the impugned detention order dated 25.05.2021.

The respondents are directed to set the detenu namely Allani Shyam S/o.Somaiah, Age : 49 yrs, R/o.Road No.5, Nagole, L.B.Nagar,
N/o.H.No.2-4-193/1, Sitharam Puram, Miryalaguda Town, Nalgonda District at liberty forthwith, if he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.
P.NAVEEN RAO,J ______________________ Dr. G.RADHA RANI,J 17th February, 2022 Rds P Keshav vs The State Of Telangana And 2 Others
